mechanism: Both drugs increase dopaminergic activity through different pathways (pramipexole as D2/D3 agonist, lisdexamfetamine as indirect sympathomimetic), creating additive effects on dopamine neurotransmission and sympathomimetic stimulation.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with caution under close monitoring; if combination necessary, reduce doses and monitor for excessive dopaminergic effects including psychosis, dyskinesias, hyperthermia, and cardiovascular effects.
